notes.title: Aldro Resurrection Update! Release v2.0
notes.notes: [p]*Aldro Resurrection Update Patch Notes* v2.0[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/mhuIcZE66mE?si=1m6j1FAs12IueCIi"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Core Gameplay Systems:[/b][/p][p]-Introduced Normal Mode and Hard Mode:[/p][p]	-Normal Mode: Players retain inventory after death.[/p][p]	-Hard Mode: Features item loss on death, tougher enemies, and double loot rewards.[/p][p]-Added Advanced Mouse Tracking Camera Movement (toggleable) — camera now subtly sways with mouse movement.[/p][p]-Implemented a dynamic lighting system that darkens the environment during nighttime and in underground areas, enhancing atmosphere and immersion.[/p][p]-Implemented a 24-Hour Day/Night Cycle, adding time-based gameplay variation.[/p][p]-Introduced a new Slot Stash: A new early game placeable container with cross-save shared storage[/p][p]-Pets can be found in jars throughout the world and collected by breaking them.[/p][p]-Home raids have been overhauled with new enemy mobs and rebalanced for improved challenge and gameplay.[/p][p]-Mobs now drop Mana/HP.[/p][p][/p][p][b]User Interface (UI) Overhaul:[/b][/p][p]-The on-screen hotbar (slots 1–7) now allows instant building, consuming, or equipping upon pressing the corresponding number key—removing the previous confirmation step for faster gameplay.[/p][p]-Reworked Tutorial UI for improved user onboarding.[/p][p]-Redesigned Crafting Menu UI for better navigation.[/p][p]-Overhauled the Main Menu UI for a fresh layout.[/p][p]-Updated Death Screen UI with improved visuals and clarity.[/p][p]-Replaced all fonts with a new universal font for better readability.[/p][p]-The Crafting, Inventory, and Market Menu now display nametags when hovering over items.[/p][p]-Overhauled the item bar to improve layout and usability, preventing it from overlapping or extending beyond the screen during market and crafting menu use.[/p][p]-Screenshake has been increased.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mana System Overhauled:[/b][/p][p]-Mana no longer auto-regenerates while casting.[/p][p]-Upgrading regeneration now offers more meaningful benefits.[/p][p]-Mana Regeneration Rating has been replaced by Mana Regeneration percentage above base similar to all other stats. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Crafting System Updates:[/b][/p][p]-Added Workbench Requirements.[/p][p]-Some crafting recipes now require one of 6 new workbench types.[/p][p]-Guns & Ammo are now craftable at the Weaponsmith Workbench.[/p][p]-Numerous crafting recipes have been adjusted for smoother progression, with corresponding market price updates to maintain balance.[/p][p]Casino:[/p][p]-The Casino — A new world structure that can be found or built. Inside are 3 playable games:[/p][p]	-Blackjack[/p][p]	-Ride the Bus[/p][p]	-Slot Machines[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Artifact Slot System:[/b][/p][p]-Introduced 16 New Artifacts — a new equipment type that grants unique gameplay-altering abilities rather than modifying stats. Examples include: flight, freezing enemies, passive DPS support, spawning hp/mana stars, and many other things.[/p][p]-Players can equip up to 2 artifacts at once.[/p][p]-Added a craftable Artifacts "Resurrection Totem" prevents Aldro's death once, granting him a second chance at life upon defeat.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Weapon Additions:[/b][/p][p]-3 Guns: MP5, Spade Slinger, Tactical Shotgun[/p][p]-7 Craftable Swords (1 per element tier)[/p][p]-13 Magic Rods — a new mana-based weapon class with projectile attacks[/p][p]-Introduced three powerful new Rainbow Rarity weapons which have been added to the auction house:[/p][p]	-Spade Slinger – Fires shots that deal a random damage value between 1 and 100.[/p][p]	-Rod of Null Energy – Summons a barrage of homing rainbow stars.[/p][p]	-Rod of Aureorum – Calls forth an army of golden skeletons to fight alongside you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Items & Potions:[/b][/p][p]-Added Large Mana & HP Potions that restore 75 points.[/p][p]-Vases now drop potions when broken.[/p][p]-Added new Craftable light sources: Torches, Glowsticks, Braziers, and Standing Eridium Torches.[/p][p]-Added a Clock Object that displays in-game time.[/p][p]-Added 6 new crafting ingredients used in creating Rods, Structures, and select Artifacts.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Enemies & Bosses:[/b][/p][p]-New Core Boss: Nekrathul, summonable only at night using a special artifact.[/p][p]-Introduced new tameable wolf mob — tame with bones.[/p][p]-Added a new neutral lizard mob native to the tropical biome.[/p][p]-Introduced Rats around the darker area of Aldro.[/p][p]-Agro Mobs now spawn in all biomes. [/p][p]-Introduced Phoenixes, rare creatures found during expeditions — they drop a valuable feather used in high-tier crafting recipes.[/p][p]-Added 4 new Night-Time Mobs:[/p][p]	-Darkrog[/p][p]	-Nightcrawlers[/p][p]	-TNT Goblins[/p][p]	-Imps[/p][p]-Bosses now despawn when the player is defeated.[/p][p]-Significantly improved enemy AI with pathfinding capabilities — enemies can now intelligently navigate around obstacles to reach and engage their targets.[/p][p]-AI that use basic hand-to-hand combat now keep a respectful distance when on cooldown from attacking again. [/p][p][/p][p][b]World Content & Environments:[/b][/p][p]-Added wind simulation to small foliage for visual realism.[/p][p]-Tomb Biome overhaul.[/p][p]-Mobs now spawn more consistently during generation.[/p][p]-Map drop rates increased, unlocking new levels is now more accessible.[/p][p]-Crate drops have been increased.[/p][p]-Air drops have been decreased now that ammo is craftable.[/p][p]-Magic projectiles now emit a glowing effect accompanied by dynamic particle trails.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Zones:[/b][/p][p]-The Backrooms; a surreal, liminal space found randomly during expeditions. This eerie zone contains unpredictable, randomly generated loot and the elusive Almond Water, essential for survival.[/p][p]-The Tomb: A mysterious underground chamber located within the Tomb biome, featuring a unique sacrificial trial that, once completed, rewards Aldro with the powerful Amulet of the Undead needed to summon Nekrathul.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Progression & Achievements:[/b][/p][p]-Added 2 new quests to expand progression.[/p][p]-Added 5 new Steam Achievements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes & Stability:[/b][/p][p]-Windows mode no longer resizes when entering a new level.[/p][p]-Placing a new home flag now resets raid time.[/p][p]-Flying no longer fly's over indoor areas.[/p][p]-Fixed fatal errors causing crashes or instability.[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.06"
notes.notes:
[b]Small Hotfix:[/b]

-Lumberyards now indicate tree harvest range with a green circle.
-The "Help Wanted" quest has been re-worded and fixed to accommodate lumberyards. You are required to now place a worker hut near a lumberyard/mining node. Once the station is activated you will then be awarded the quest progression.

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.05"
notes.notes: -Random Boxes now spawn at the originally intended rate. (25% chance per level)

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.04"
notes.notes:
[b]Critical Hotfix:[/b]

Fix an issue where the Home Raid Accumulation meter would not trigger a raid as intended. Reworked the core mechanics of the script to enhance reliability. This issue was primarily observed on high-end PCs, where the frame rate would either skip lower tiers or fail to ignite at stage five keeping the player permanently stuck at tier five.

Players can now expect a fair roll at lower tiers. Chances of raid ignition have not changed at 55% chance per stage.

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.02"
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b]

-UI tabs (aka the right-hand slide out tabs) now feature titles that clearly indicate the menu they represent.
-Large rocks now yield 50% more resources than previously.
-Crates now contain Trilliants.
-Trilliants now have a chance to spawn randomly throughout the world.
-Updated descriptions for Trilliants and Gloob Crystals to clearly specify their uses.
-Increased the spawn rate of Mysterious Chests.
-Guide Quests; Added four new guide quests to help new players understand important features that were previously unexplained.
-Quest Progression; Reorganized quests based on feedback from beta testers to better match the average progression order.

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.01"
notes.notes:
[b]Small Hotfix:[/b]

[b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b]

-The map will now spawn 20% more often to unlock new biomes.
-Snow Staff's spawn rate has been increased by 25%.

[b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b]

-The number keys allocated to the on screen hotbar will now be directed to the radial menu. This allows for a smoother experience without forced -mouse movements.
-Simple Font has been overhauled and is now the Default Font when loading Aldro for the first time.
-Cursor size can now be adjusted in your settings.
-Cursor has been overhauled to improve interaction with clicking.
-Patched various UI bugs when operating controllers and keyboards simultaneously.
-MISC bug fixes.

notes.title: Aldro v1.0 is HERE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43986127/72a70a46f2a77960a5f6129884fe68966bf60d28.png[/img]

[b]New Weapons and Raid Content:[/b]

-Explore the new "Laboratory Zone" raid, accessible via key card drops from military airdrops. This area features exclusive Rainbow gun drops and introduces a formidable mini-boss named "Big-man."
-A diverse array of 13 new firearms have been introduced, including the Tactical M4, Stealth M4, SR2M, AK-47, AK-74, Vector, The Stick, Basic Shotgun, and Basic Marksman Rifle.
-Additionally, four exclusive Rainbow rarity guns—PKM, Flintlock, Baby-Unmaker, and Margret—are now obtainable through raids and auctions.
-The Snowstaff has been added. This ungodly power can be found randomly within the snow region (1% chance to spawn) as well as in the Auction House. This Staff has a shooting mode that freezes enemies on contact.

[b]New Features:[/b]

-The new Wastelands biome brings forth the rare eridum resource, dragonflies, and a new mob faction of resistance forces.
-Introducing the new craftable item, "Tent Reinforcement," which deploys two ally fighters for defense or offense at the cost of 1 defense point.
-Introduced a new craftable building: the "Lumberyard," deployable in levels to automatically harvest logs based on nearby trees. Requires a nearby worker to operate and collect both beachwood and normal logs depending on surrounding tree types.
-Introducing the new craftable item, "Hama Coop,” Hama Coops generates Hama milk, which can be used to craft recipes or consumed directly for two food points. 
-Players can now craft/utilize the Realm Table, powered with eridum, to temporarily enchant the exit portal, focusing on specific biomes for strategic gameplay enhancements.
-Introduced Orange Trees to the Tropic biome, a new farmable plant enriching agricultural options for players.
-Implemented random spawns of military airdrops guarded by armed resistance across all biomes, offering exclusive access to essential ammo and firearms.
-All Process Stations are now obtainable through auctions.

[b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b]

-Significant overhaul of the raid system aimed at improving accessibility for new players. Wave structures have been adjusted, introducing new enemy types and reducing overall difficulty.
-Increased spawn rates for both maps and natural rock ores to facilitate smoother progression and crafting opportunities.
-Increased spawn rate for processors and traders.
-Implemented a 3-second force field for Aldro, granting temporary invincibility upon entering new levels or at the start of raid waves, ensuring a smoother transition into unfamiliar areas.
-All Major bosses have received a HP nerf. 
-The Auction House now auctions every 10 minutes rather than the previous 15 minute cooldown. 

[b]Visual Enhancements:[/b]

-Introduced a new visual hotbar on screen. This functionality now allows for quick access to items, now including the ability to equip food directly from any hotbar.
-The main menu screen has been revamped with a more visually appealing design to enhance the initial player experience.
-Updates to the lighting system have been implemented to improve overall visual quality and atmospheric immersion.
-Complete overhaul of the HUD with new sprites and graphics for a polished and streamlined interface.

[b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b]

-Dropped items now feature a glowing indicator denoting their rarity, aiding players in identifying valuable loot quickly.
-Introduction of crop indicators near farm homes visually displays the enhanced growth buff provided by proximity to these structures.
-Auto mining objects now feature indicators highlighting resource requirements, facilitating a clearer understanding and management of resource generation.
-Hama’s are now able to be trapped in a cage. 

[b]Miscellaneous Additions:[/b]

-Introduction of a Processor; Cake Processor; producing the new Cake item. Consuming Cake temporarily doubles sword and gun damage and boosts HP by 50%. Cake can also be sold at the Cake Trader. 
-All processed goods now sell for substantially more. 
-The trader economy now includes new resource traders such as the Cake Trader, Horn Trader, and Eridum Trader. The Horn Trader spawns exclusively in the snow biome.

[b]Bug Fixes and Optimization:[/b]

-Addressed bugs related to the functionality of the Last Resort Pill when used within home levels, ensuring consistent gameplay mechanics.
-Various optimizations and adjustments to improve overall game stability and performance.
-The Princess Balloon is now a mineable object, which resolves previous issues where it obstructed the exit portal.
-Gamepad now supports both mouse movement and gamepad movement. This allows players to utilize both at once.
-During application startup, the window will no longer be extremely small.

[b]Community and Player Interaction:[/b]

-Several new guide quests have been added, offering players additional content and exploration opportunities.
-Expanded the achievement system with four new Steam achievements to challenge and reward player progression.
-Updated the Attribution page to credit new assets and individuals who contributed to the game's development.

notes.title: Patch Notes "v0.1.0.3"
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes "v0.1.0.3"[/b]

-Banks have been implemented along with a universal character currency.
-Blacksmiths now appear around the map and are craftable.
-Heavy Alloy Processing has now been added.
-Revamped the Equipped item system to allow for more complex melees.
-Staffs have been re-worked to have healing abilities.
-Umbrellas have been added.
-Added the Defense Stand, a cheaper cost defense tower manned by residents.
-Revamped Save System to allow for real-time updates without corrupting.
-Added a Control Menu to view source controls.
-Balanced loot tables & market prices.
-Added Zoom keybinds "-+"
-Added 4 new Radio Songs in rotation.
-Added 8 new steam achievements.
-Fixed 3 Fatal Errors & MISC Bug Fixes.
